tweets.text: "As we battle the coronavirus pandemic, heroic first responders and medical professionals have made significant contributions and immeasurable sacrifices to ensure our communities are safe and healthy."

tweets.text: "The First Lady and I thank all those who have donated their time and resources through acts of kindness and charitable giving."
